ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels primarily localized at the basal water-interface; estimated white-to-black ratio < 0.15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark contiguous pigmentation covering approx. 90% of the visible surface; light-grey diffuse pixel clusters mapped to the basal region at x-axis coordinates [0.40, 0.60] and y-axis [0.80, 1.0].

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to width of approx. 0.25.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire length of the trailing edge, characterized by pixel-amplitude spikes (peaks) of 3-5 pixels depth relative to the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature from the median notch to the distal fluke tips on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Punctate white pixel clusters visible on the surface of both lobes, possibly representing scarring or barnacle attachment sites, but resolution precludes definitive geometric classification.
